verdict.rationale: Cekura is a SaaS evaluation platform, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair axis. Its docs include a dedicated MCP overview page for installing "Cekura Skills and MCP" so an AI assistant can design, run, and improve voice-agent evaluations, and a probe confirms the official MCP server documentation. An agent-integration guide also covers Claude Code, Cursor, and VS Code Copilot. Missing for 10: detail on the MCP server's exposed tools, transport, and authentication, and independent or hands-on corroboration that connecting an agent works as documented.
